answer: Before an agent can claim a rebate on vine supports, marble tiles or a prism, lock a separate bond for that order. Randomly audit deliveries using independently assigned inspectors; a fabricated order forfeits its bond. Do not let concurrent orders share collateral, even across accounts. If audit probability p and bond B satisfy pB > the maximum fake-order rebate, each additional alias has negative expected profit and ties up more capital. This depends on inspectors resisting collusion and bonds remaining locked until audits finish.
